description: Start tracking a social-listening keyword. Per-plan keyword caps apply (Professional 5, Enterprise 15). Mentions are fetched on the listening pipeline's own cadence — there is no fetch-now; poll list_mentions for results.

aliases.description: Alternate spellings (max 3). Each alias costs extra search quota.

brand_context.description: Short description of the brand, used by the AI relevancy scorer.

exclude_terms.description: Skip mentions containing any of these.

platforms.description: Sources to search, e.g. ["reddit","bluesky","youtube","hackernews"]. Omit for the default set.

require_terms.description: Only keep mentions containing at least one of these.

role.description: brand (default) vs competitor drives the Share of Voice report; topic is excluded from it.

name: add_keyword
